title: OpenSchwa exercise
description: One scripted drill. Authored in YAML, validated at pack load. Rules not expressible here, enforced by the content loader: segmental types need exactly one phone with focus=true; intonation type requires the prosody block.

ph.description: Canonical IPA label from the engine's internal inventory.

focus.description: The contrast under drill. Exactly one per segmental exercise.

confusions.description: Typical L2 substitutions to discriminate against, e.g. [z, d, v] for /ð/.

pair_with.description: Exercise id of the other half of a minimal pair.

reference_audio.description: Path relative to the pack root, e.g. audio/this-ref.wav

nuclear_syllable_index.description: Author-marked nucleus (syllable index in `text`). No automatic accent detection.

learner_notes.description: Articulation hint shown to the student, written by the exercise author.
